page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr6.20xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 80 dedicated physical cores and 80 vCPUs on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing the Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz. The instance is configured with 1.0 thread per core, ensuring dedicated compute resources without hyperthreading. It is equipped with 768.0 GB of system memory, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 9.6 GB per core.

This instance does not include local NVMe or SSD storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 25 Gbps. The lack of bundled local storage and dedicated GPU hardware represents a clear tradeoff, positioning this server specifically for workloads that rely on external storage arrays and do not require hardware-accelerated graphics processing.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.hfr6.20xlarge offers a dense memory configuration relative to its dedicated compute resources, making it suitable for memory-intensive enterprise applications. The combination of 80 dedicated physical cores and 768 GB of RAM makes this instance well-suited for large-scale in-memory databases, enterprise resource planning systems, heavy caching layers, and memory-bound data processing workloads.
